title: Finn Balor And Becky Lynch Appearing For Zuffa Boxing - NewsBreak
text:
By Thomas Lowson ,
29 minutes ago
WWE Superstars Finn Balor and Becky Lynch will be part of the festivities for Zuffa Boxing when the promotion comes to Ireland next month.
The pair will make VIP appearances at Zuffa Boxing 10 on August 8 in Dublin, with a promotional graphic confirming their involvement.
Balor appeared on a Zuffa Boxing 10 press conference panel in June, where he was asked about stepping into boxing or MMA himself.
The first-ever WWE Universal Champion was quick to shut the idea down, admitting that he’d “ rather stay exactly in my lane in WWE .”
Lynch is from Dublin while Balor is from Bray in County Wicklow, less than an hour’s drive from Dublin, the capital of the Republic of Ireland.
Lynch has been off of TV since the June 8th episode of WWE RAW. Balor will face Sami Zayn at WWE SummerSlam for a shot at the WWE Championship.
